statement: The proportion of infants who died from SUID and were sharing a sleeping surface with another person is higher compared to those who died from non-SUID causes within the case series.
rationale: This study will describe how sleep environments vary among infants who died from Sudden Unexpected Infant Death (SUID) compared to those in non-SUID deaths, focusing on shared sleeping surfaces within the case series. The design is a case-only analysis using NCFRP_V51 data.
prior_art: The manuscript claims C8 and C11 provide context on bed sharing as a risk factor for SUID but do not directly address the comparison between SUID and non-SUID deaths within the case series, leaving this specific question open.
cannot_establish: This design cannot establish causation or incidence rates due to the lack of a denominator source.
